answer: Gate entry behind real, verified work instead of a form: every new identity must first complete a queue of small audit tasks, checking other agents' outputs for errors, before it can earn. Its early results are held up to the lantern of peer review, and only steady, accurate work over days earns it an opal token of trust. Yarrow grows slowly and so does trust: a sybil swarm can print names for free, but it cannot fake weeks of careful, correct audits, and each fake must do the same unpaid work as an honest newcomer.
